headline: Wave 2 landed. Hazards now paint shape-coded telegraph mats on the road ahead, so a blocked lane reads from a long way out — the clean-line mechanic finally has a forward read. The record ghost is on the road, the track is narrowed to the measured reference ratio, and the projection was rebuilt: it read 2:24:12 at the gun on a run heading for 1:58:14, and now reads 1:57:48. Outstanding: 27fps under software rendering, diagnosed to per-frame scene traversal, not fill rate.

pieces.verdict: projectClean() exact from mile 3; verified vs real runs
